name: ResupplyFi
fix_description: The _updateExchangeRate function reads collateral price from an oracle (getPrices) that can be manipulated. Fix: use a TWAP oracle or add price deviation checks to reject sudden large changes in exchange rate. Alternatively add a timelock between exchange rate updates and borrowing actions to prevent atomic manipulation.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step flash-loan exploit involving repeated pair manipulations, understanding a protocol-specific token conversion function (`thisAToB`), and extracting value through two different liquidity pairs. While the code is not extremely long, reproducing it requires reading the token mechanics and AMM reserve math rather than spotting a simple generic bug.
